definitions.explanation: An aquatic plant with large round leaves and distinctive pink or white flowers. Deeply significant in Buddhism and Japanese culture.

examples.english: Lotus flowers are blooming in the pond.
Water droplets were glistening on a lotus leaf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蓮|はす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見頃|みごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, the lotus in this park reaches its peak viewing season.

notes:
The lotus holds deep significance in Japanese Buddhism. It symbolizes purity because it blooms beautifully despite growing from muddy water — a metaphor for spiritual enlightenment arising from the suffering of the material world. The lotus is depicted in Buddhist art beneath statues of the Buddha and bodhisattvas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蓮|はす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: lotus flower
- {蓮|はす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧: lotus leaf
- {蓮|はす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧: lotus seed
- ⟦{蓮根|れんこん}→蓮根：13994_renkon⟧: lotus root (a common vegetable in Japanese cuisine)
- {蓮|はす}{池|いけ}: lotus pond

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {睡蓮|すいれん}: water lily — often confused with lotus, but a different plant with leaves that float flat on the water
- ⟦{蓮根|れんこん}→蓮根：13994_renkon⟧: lotus root — the edible underground stem of the lotus plant, commonly used in cooking

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Buddhist phrase {泥中|でいちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蓮|はす} (lotus in the mud) expresses the idea of maintaining purity amid corruption. The {蓮華座|れんげざ} (lotus position) is the cross-legged meditation posture depicted in Buddhist statuary.
